content.text:
Nothing checked turned up for Saturday that fits a 5 and an 8 year old. The one web result is for kids under 3, so I'm skipping it.

High Park is a good bet. Saturday looks sunny and dry, around 29. It has the Jamie Bell Adventure Playground, a free animal display with bison, llamas and peacocks, and a wading pool and splash pads. The water play is seasonal, but it should be on in August. It's on the west end by Bloor St W and Parkside Dr.
